result.stdout:
Cryptex 2.0.0 - encrypt and decrypt files and folders with AES-256-GCM

Usage:
  cryptex encrypt <inputFile> <outputFile> [options]   (alias: e)
  cryptex decrypt <inputFile> <outputFile> [options]   (alias: d)
  cryptex encrypt-folder <folderPath> [options]        (alias: ef)
  cryptex decrypt-folder <folderPath> [options]        (alias: df)

Options:
  -p, --passphrase <pass>  Passphrase (visible to other processes and shell history;
                           prefer the prompt or the environment variable)
  -x, --delete-original    Delete source files after successful encryption
  -h, --help               Show this help
  -v, --version            Show the version

Passphrase sources, in order: --passphrase, the CRYPTEX_PASSPHRASE environment
variable, then an interactive prompt.

Existing output files are overwritten. Markdown files (.md, .markdown) are never
encrypted. There is no way to recover data if the passphrase is lost.

Cryptex is free software provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. See the
MIT license at https://github.com/greatb/Cryptex/blob/main/LICENSE
